sizeAttributeSplit.description: 32 components have a 'size' property. 19 use the custom 'hx-size' attribute (form/interactive components), while 13 use the standard 'size' attribute (presentational components). This creates an inconsistent consumer experience.
sizeAttributeSplit.recommendation: Standardize all components to use 'hx-size' attribute. Add deprecation warning for 'size' attribute in v1.x, remove in v2.0.

typeVsVariant.description: 21 components use 'variant' for visual style options. 2 sub-components (hx-list-item, hx-menu-item) incorrectly use 'type' for visual variants. 3 components (hx-button, hx-text-input, hx-icon-button) correctly use 'type' for HTML-native purposes.
typeVsVariant.recommendation: Rename 'type' to 'variant' on hx-list-item and hx-menu-item. Add deprecation alias in v1.x, remove in v2.0.

booleanDefaultTrue.description: 10 properties across 8 components default to true, which is unusual for HTML boolean attributes. Some are semantically correct (dialog.modal, dialog.closable, drawer.closable, drawer.overlay, side-nav.collapsible, toast.closable, skeleton.animated), while others need review (banner.open, table.fullWidth, code-snippet.copyable, pagination.showFirstLast, rating.interactive).

approvedExceptions.rationale: Dialogs should be modal by default per WAI-ARIA best practices
Overlay expected by default for drawers
Collapsibility expected for responsive side nav

needsReview.issue: Banners showing by default may flash before JS dismisses them
Not standard default; tables are often constrained
Opt-in is safer for code snippets in read-only contexts
Display-only should be the default; interaction should be opt-in

booleanDefaultTrue.recommendation: Review each case individually. banner.open, table.fullWidth, code-snippet.copyable, and rating.interactive should default to false in v2.0.

nonStandardNaming.description: Several components use non-standard property/attribute naming patterns that deviate from library conventions.

affectedComponents.issue: Should be 'href' like hx-button and hx-link
Property should be 'size' with 'hx-size' attribute, not 'hxSize' as property name
Non-standard naming; should use internal state or standard boolean

nonStandardNaming.recommendation: Fix all non-standard names. hx-card: rename hxHref to href, hxAriaLabel to ariaLabel. hx-field: rename hxSize property to size.

hxPrefixCompliance.description: All 45+ custom events use the 'hx-' prefix consistently. 100% compliance.
hxPrefixCompliance.recommendation: No action needed. Event naming is exemplary.

inconsistentEventDetails.description: Some events with the same name have different detail types across components.

affectedComponents.issue: badge/tag fire void detail, file-upload fires {file, index}
image fires void detail, file-upload fires rich detail
popup fires void, split-panel fires {position: number}

inconsistentEventDetails.recommendation: Standardize event details: hx-remove should always include {item, index?}. hx-error should always include {error, details?}.

showHideVsOpenClose.description: Overlay components use hx-show/hx-hide events, while dialog uses hx-open/hx-close. This creates confusion about which event pair to listen for.
showHideVsOpenClose.recommendation: Standardize on hx-show/hx-hide for all overlay components. Add hx-show/hx-hide as aliases on hx-dialog, deprecate hx-open/hx-close for v2.0.

helpTextConsistency.description: 11 form components consistently use 'help-text' as a slot name. No 'help' or 'footer-help' variations found. Slot naming is consistent.
helpTextConsistency.recommendation: No action needed. help-text slot naming is consistent.

prefixSuffixCoverage.description: Not all form input components expose prefix/suffix slots consistently.
prefixSuffixCoverage.recommendation: Add prefix/suffix slots to hx-textarea where semantically useful. Checkbox, switch, slider correctly omit these.

errorNaming.description: CSS part naming for error containers varies: some use 'error', others use 'error-message'.
errorNaming.recommendation: Standardize to 'error' (shorter, consistent with slot naming). Add 'error' as alias on checkbox-group and radio-group.

baseVsContainerNaming.description: Most components use 'base' for the outermost wrapper. Some use 'container' (hx-stat). This is minor but inconsistent.
baseVsContainerNaming.recommendation: Low priority. Stat has both 'base' and 'container' which is acceptable.

hardcodedValues.description: 43+ components have hardcoded fallback values (hex colors, rgb, pixel values) in their styles instead of using token references.
hardcodedValues.recommendation: Replace hardcoded fallbacks with semantic tokens. This is a non-breaking change that can be done incrementally.

hxPrefixCompliance.description: All CSS custom properties follow the --hx- prefix convention. 100% compliance.

showHideVsOpenClose.description: Dialog uses show()/showModal()/close(), drawer uses show()/close(), color-picker uses show()/hide(), code-snippet uses show()/hide(). The method names are inconsistent for overlay patterns.
showHideVsOpenClose.recommendation: Standardize: overlay components (dialog, drawer) use show()/close(). Collapsible content (code-snippet) uses expand()/collapse(). Color-picker as dropdown uses show()/hide().

formValidationConsistency.description: All 10 form components consistently implement checkValidity() and reportValidity(). Consistent pattern.
formValidationConsistency.recommendation: No action needed. Form validation API is consistent.

reflection.description: Attribute reflection is generally consistent: visual state properties (variant, size, open, disabled, expanded) reflect, while content properties (label, placeholder, value for strings) do not. Boolean form properties (required, checked) reflect correctly.
reflection.recommendation: No action needed. Reflection patterns are intentional and correct.
